title: 白梅與禽（1985.371）

one_line: 克利夫兰美术馆藏画作，馆方断代作「1100s」。**本条为著录级**：照录馆方记录，未作阐释。

The Kelvin Smith Collection, given by Mrs. Kelvin Smith

basics.text: **本条为著录级条目。**以上各项照录克利夫兰美术馆的藏品记录，字段名标明「馆方」者即其原文。本库尚未对其作独立核校，亦未就断代、归属、风格作任何判断——分期归入依据仅为：朝代名 → southern-song；器类归入依据仅为：type=Painting。

items: Ho, Wai-kam, Sherman E. Lee, Laurence Sickman, and Marc F. Wilson. Eight Dynasties of Chinese Painting: The Collections of the Nelson Gallery-Atkins Museum, Kansas City, and the Cleveland Museum of Art. Cleveland, OH: Cleveland Museum of Art, in cooperation with Indiana University Press, 1980.（Mentioned and Reproduced: p. 59, cat. no. 44）
Cunningham, Michael R. “Painting the Poetry of the Natural World.” The Bulletin of the Cleveland Museum of Art 75, no. 7 (September 1988): 279–291.（Mentioned and reproduced: pp. 282–283, fig. 3）
Laozi 老子 and James Legge, translator. Tao Te Ching 道德经. New York: Metro Books, 2008.（Reproduced: fig. 24）

dating.text: 馆方给出了年代，**但未在公开记录中说明这个年代依据什么**——是铭文、器形序列、共出器物还是风格比对，无从得知。本库的断代十档因此无法填写：**填任何一档都是替馆方作了它没作的声明。**

colophons.text: 2 seals: 1 official seal of the Yuan Dynasty; 1 unidentified partial seal.
